mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, project_id, monomer_id, area_id, project_type, product_type, category, product_id, serial_number, name, specification, report_quantity, report_mete, supplier_id, supplier_name, user_id, audit_status, actual_quantity, actual_mete, audit_time, audit_user_id, report_method
mapper.select: select supplier_id, supplier_name, product_type, sum(report_mete) / 1000 as mete, sum(report_quantity) as quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') THEN report_mete ELSE 0 END) / 1000 AS currentMonthMete, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') THEN report_mete ELSE 0 END) / 1000 AS lastMonthMete, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') THEN report_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS currentMonthQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') THEN report_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS lastMonthQuantity from project_install_report where bool_delete_enum = 0 and audit_status = 2 and project_id = #{projectId} group by supplier_id,supplier_name,product_type

select product_type, sum(report_mete) / 1000 as mete, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') THEN report_mete ELSE 0 END) / 1000 AS currentMonthMete, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') THEN report_mete ELSE 0 END) / 1000 AS lastMonthMete, sum(report_quantity) as quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') THEN report_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS currentMonthQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') THEN report_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS lastMonthQuantity from project_install_report where bool_delete_enum = 0 and audit_status = 2 and project_id = #{projectId} and product_type = #{productType}

select a.*, pm.id 'monomer.id', pm.`name` 'monomer.name', pa.id 'area.id', pa.`name` 'area.name' from ( select product_id, name, serial_number, specification, monomer_id, area_id, measure_unit, accounting_unit, sum(report_quantity) as report_quantity, sum(report_mete) as report_mete from project_install_report where bool_delete_enum = 0 and audit_status = 2 and project_id = #{projectId} and product_type = #{productType}
AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d' )
AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d' )
group by product_id, name, serial_number, specification, monomer_id, area_id, measure_unit, accounting_unit )a LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.id = a.monomer_id LEFT JOIN plan_area pa ON pa.id = a.area_id
